gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the quiet or slow charging settings it recommends have to be turned on in the maker's phone app. On the BLUETTI AC180, Turbo and Silent are turned on in the BLUETTI app. On the Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2, both the AC charging speed and the 1,600 W UltraFast mode are set in the Anker app. Without UltraFast, its AC charging on 120 V tops out at 1,200 W.
standout_why: I read the three pages ChatGPT cited most. thepowerstationguide.com (noise-level guide) says only that Anker 'exposes AC recharge speed in its app'. voltandvalley.com says 'several brands expose a charge-speed setting in their app' and names no model. Our own current page says 'set the lowest AC charge rate in the app before bed' but never says Silent on the AC180 is an app setting, never gives the Anker 1,200 W limit without UltraFast, and never says UltraFast is app-only. None of the three says how DJI's or Jackery's quiet mode is selected, or which input a quiet mode applies to. Rivals already cover part of this, so it scores 1.
decides: It confirms the pick and adds a setup condition; it does not change the ranking. For the AC180 and C1000 Gen 2, the quiet result ChatGPT quoted (about 37 dB in Silent; fans off at 200 W) only happens after the owner changes a setting in the app. For the AC180, it also needs the unit paired with the app first. Out of the box, the Anker charges at up to 1,200 W on 120 V. This makes DJI Power 1000 V2 more attractive for shoppers who don't want to use an app, but only if DJI's mode switch is a physical control. I could not confirm that from a DJI page I opened (see unsourced).

findings.label: How the charging modes are selected
findings.value: In the BLUETTI app: 'Turbo and silent modes can be enabled in BLUETTI app.'
findings.source_title: Bluetti AC180 User Manual (ManualsLib copy), p.16 Charging
findings.note: Quoted from the Charging section (p.16) of BLUETTI's manual as hosted on ManualsLib. The same page says 'Turbo charging comes in handy when you need AC180 to be replenished in short time' and 'Standard charging is more friendly to AC180's battery'. The section was cut off, so this copy doesn't give the default mode, the wattage of each mode, or whether the modes apply to AC input only. BLUETTI's own PDF (cdn.shopify.com AC180_User_Manual.pdf) downloaded but its text couldn't be extracted.

findings.label: A separate app setting that is not a charging mode
findings.value: Grid Enhancement mode is 'disabled' by default and is turned on in the BLUETTI app
findings.source_title: Bluetti AC180 User Manual (ManualsLib copy), p.14
findings.note: Included so the page doesn't mix it up with Turbo, Standard and Silent.

findings.label: UltraFast AC charging needs the app
findings.value: 'UltraFast Recharging must be activated via the Anker app.' UltraFast is 1,600 W; otherwise AC charging is 1,200 W max
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen2 (Anker SOLIX Canada product page)
findings.note: This is Anker's Canadian page. The US product URL I tried (anker.com/products/a1763-...) returned 404. The page lists the AC input as '120V~ 12A Max, 60Hz', the same grid voltage as the US. It also lists AC bypass at 1,800 W max, and full charge in 49 min at 1,600 W.

findings.label: Charging-speed control
findings.value: 'Set AC Recharging Speed' is listed as an Anker app feature. The page gives no wattage steps.
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen2 (Anker SOLIX Canada product page)
findings.note: So the 200 W fans-off result ChatGPT cited depends on choosing a lower AC speed in the app. This page does not mention a 'Silent recharging' mode.

findings.label: Anker's only dB claim is for discharging
findings.value: 'Quietly Discharges at 20 dB Under 200W' (discharging, not charging; no test distance given)
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen2 (Anker SOLIX Canada product page)
findings.note: thepowerstationguide.com lists this same figure as '20 dB (<200 W discharge)'. It should not appear in a charging-noise column.

findings.label: Cable limit stated by the maker
findings.value: 'Please charge using the standard Anker SOLIX AC charging cable, as incompatible third-party cables may cause damage.'
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen2 (Anker SOLIX Canada product page)
findings.note: Footnote on the AC charging claim.

Jackery Explorer 1000 v2: whether Quiet Charging Mode and Emergency Super Charging can only be turned on in the Jackery app (search snippets say yes), plus the wattage and time to full in Quiet mode. jackery.com and au.jackery.com returned 429. The hampshiregenerators.co.uk manual PDF downloaded, but its text couldn't be extracted.

BLUETTI AC180: the default charging mode, the input wattage in Silent, Standard and Turbo, and whether the modes cover AC input only. BLUETTI's US product page returned 429, the official manual PDF's text couldn't be extracted, and the ManualsLib copy was cut off.

Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2: the lowest AC charging speed the app allows and the steps between settings, and a 'Silent recharging' mode under 600 W (seen only in a search snippet). Anker's US user guide PDF (A17631A1_US_UG_V2) was over the 10 MB fetch limit, and the US product URL returned 404.
